purpose: List optional skills, MCP and applications usable by existing specialist agents: skills/tools do not become agent personas.
identity_policy: The seven imported/community-derived specialists retain source attribution; external software and skills are provider-owned capabilities, not IA-Gov agents.
installation_policy: Listing tools or agent personas in GitHub does not install software, configure the MCP server, log into services, or verify local connections.
connection_state_note: Each specialist MUST check actual host capability/authorization before claiming tool use; fallback to local skillful work if unavailable.

tools.integration: install upstream skill and configure local designer-skill MCP; no API key for core

tools.license: MIT (skill source); hosted service terms separate
tools.integration: install skill and CLI, then interactive superdesign login; call only with user consent
tools.fallback: Agency UI Designer and local frontend code

tools.license: Apache-2.0 for open-source repository; hosted terms separate
tools.runtime: current hosted product early access; OSS self-host requires substantial stack
tools.integration: select hosted or authorized self-hosted editor; no automatic Codex/Agency App API integration assumed
tools.access: hosted_waitlist; selfhost_deps; optional AI keys and related costs
tools.fallback: local frontend developer and UI Designer

tools.integration: install Streamlit as project dependency, build and run Python app locally
tools.access: free_local_software; optional Community Cloud with hosting/data constraints
tools.fallback: use existing Python tools or another authorized BI stack

tools.runtime: Linux/containerized stack; Docker + Compose for local sandbox; not officially supported native Windows
tools.integration: connect authorized running instance and data sources; no auto-deploy
tools.access: free_OSS; infrastructure/ops and data-source costs possible
tools.fallback: Streamlit for smaller projects; existing approved BI systems

tools.license: AGPL for OSS code; commercial license for enterprise components
tools.runtime: Docker or Java self-host; existing DB connection
tools.integration: connect authorized running Metabase OSS instance; permissions and API authentication as required
tools.access: free_selfhost_OSS; commercial features, cloud and operational costs separate

routing_policy: Route work by specialty (design, applications, data/BI, QA), choose optional tools only when authorized, available and advantageous.
